Reword the lede to "A rough estimate of your life expectancy from simple lifestyle adjustments" and the meta to "Estimate your remaining years from your age, sex and lifestyle. fixes.fixCorrection: The direction is right. Three refinements. (1) Don't add birth-based lifestyle adjustments (smoking -10, diabetes -6) unscaled to remaining life expectancy at older ages: a 70-year-old smoker would get 4 years. Scale each adjustment by remaining LE at the current age divided by LE at birth, or by a published hazard ratio, and keep a floor so the result never reaches 0 for a living person. (2) Name the table you use on the page (SSA is US-only and the page is served in ja). (3) The meta description is generator-owned: change it in scripts/build-tools-seo.mjs (the SEO override at line 969, plus the desc and cardDesc at line 46), not only in tools/*.html, or the next build reverts it. The 'How the estimate is calculated' paragraph (tbff000f008, the 73.8/79.0 baseline) must change too.
